description: This script seeds a local SQLite database with synthetic workflow data for the AgentField system, generating DAGs of workflow executions, steps, and timeline events for UI visualization.

classes.name: AgentNodeDefinition
classes.description: Defines the configuration for an agent node, including its URL, version, reasoners, skills, and metadata.

classes.name: WorkflowScenario
classes.description: Represents a generated workflow scenario with IDs, names, tags, actor, session, and timing info.

classes.name: NodeRecord
classes.description: Represents a single node execution within a workflow, including payloads, status, timing, and notes.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for workflow seeding parameters.

methods.name: ensure_agent_nodes
methods.description: Inserts or updates predefined agent node metadata into the database.

methods.name: purge_workflows_with_prefix
methods.description: Deletes existing workflows and related data with IDs matching a given prefix.

methods.name: choose_weighted
methods.description: Selects an option based on weighted probabilities.

methods.name: isoformat
methods.description: Converts a datetime object to ISO 8601 string without microseconds.

methods.name: generate_scenario
methods.description: Creates a new synthetic workflow scenario with IDs, name, tags, actor, and timing.

methods.name: synthesize_nodes
methods.description: Generates a list of NodeRecord objects representing the nodes in a workflow.

methods.name: insert_workflow
methods.description: Inserts a complete workflow and its nodes, steps, events, and related data into the database.

methods.name: seed_database
methods.description: Coordinates the seeding process: optionally purges existing workflows, generates scenarios, and inserts data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the script; parses args, runs seeding, and outputs status.
